question: At a heating rate of 20 °C/min, what initial and burnout temperatures did the corn straw–oil sludge composite pellet fuel have?
rendered: According to Table 4, at a heating rate of 20 °C/min, the initial temperature (Ti) and burnout temperature (Tb) of the corn straw–oil sludge composite pellet fuel (CF) were 272.6 °C and 505.8 °C, respectively.
